description: Search UCC (Uniform Commercial Code) financing-statement filings by debtor business name, for Colorado, Connecticut or Oregon (each state's own public Secretary of State open-data portal). Business debtors only — individual debtors are excluded at the source query, never fetched. Oregon's result set covers a rolling ~30-day window; Vermont has no automatable source (its one public search is reCAPTCHA-gated) and returns a loud error, not an empty list. Not a consumer report. Not for use in credit, employment, insurance or housing eligibility decisions (FCRA).

debtor_name.description: Business debtor name (or fragment) to search for, e.g. "Green Mountain Coffee".

state.description: Two-letter state code: CO, CT, OR, or VT (VT always errors — see tool description).

name: ucc_search
title: Ucc Search
